title: Replace Commander with a Bun-native CLI parser
description: Replace Commander with a local typed parser and dispatcher based on Bun.argv. Preserve every current command, argument grammar, option default, help surface, --root and --json behavior, diagnostics, and exit status in source and compiled binary modes. Remove commander only after compatibility verification.
acceptance: All existing CLI command and option contracts are covered by source-mode and compiled-binary tests.
The native parser preserves global --root and --json behavior, help output, diagnostics, and nonzero exit codes.
Commander is removed from package.json and bun.lock only after the replacement passes release gates.
Bun 1.4 frozen install, tests, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass.
notes: See docs/bun-native-stack-migration-plan.md. Keep command specifications typed and centralized; do not move business logic out of src/core.
